items.title: Every associated prime of a module lies in its support
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For an R-module M the lemma states that the associated primes of M form a subset of the support of M (statement lines 15334-15338). The proof does not go through primary decomposition or through annihilator ideals of the module as a whole: it takes an element m whose annihilator is the associated prime p, notes that this is exactly the statement that no element outside p annihilates m, and reads the resulting nonvanishing of the localisation as membership in the support (proof lines 15340-15345). Converting the annihilator condition into a localisation statement is the content, and the author writes it out. H2.
